Stellar Glimmer Reactions

Stellar Swirl is the Stellar Glimmer Reaction triggered by inflicting Anemo on a target that is already affected by Cryo, replacing Cryo Swirl while a character with a corresponding Stellar Jubilee Passive is in the party. This reaction deals Anemo DMG and creates a Stellar Vortex that will explode after a period of time, dealing Cryo DMG. If Stellar Swirl is triggered with a Vortex nearby, its level will raise, causing it to deal increased DMG in a larger AoE.

Damage[]

Main article: Damage § Stellar Glimmer Reaction Damage

When Stellar Swirl is triggered, an instance of Anemo DMG is dealt to the target opponent, and then a Lv. 1 Stellar Vortex is created that lasts for 3s. Stellar Vortices will explode after a delay, dealing AoE Cryo DMG. After triggering Stellar Swirl for the third time, the Vortex will level up to Lv. 2, after which it will deal greater DMG across a wider AoE upon bursting. If Stellar Swirl is triggered three more times, the Vortex will explode immediately.

Additionally, for 5s after a Stellar Vortex explodes, the player's next jump will have its height increased.

Tutorial[]

Elemental Reaction: Stellar Swirl
When Anemo meets Cryo, and certain other conditions are met, a special Stellar Swirl reaction is triggered. This deals an instance of Anemo DMG to the opponent and generates a Stellar Vortex.
Triggering Stellar Swirl multiple times raises the level of the Stellar Vortex, which explodes after a certain time or after a certain number of Stellar Swirl reactions have been triggered. This deals AoE Cryo DMG to nearby opponents.
The aforementioned DMG can CRIT.
Up to one Stellar Vortex can exist on the field within a certain range.
A Stellar Vortex on the field will level up to Lv. 2 after a certain number of Stellar Swirl reactions have been triggered. A higher-level Vortex deals more AoE Cryo DMG to opponents over a wider area when it explodes. After a Stellar Swirl reaction is triggered, certain nearby characters will also enter the Radiance: Stellar Swirl effect for 8s, which enhances certain Talents and skill effects.
Certain characters can use their Talents to deal Stellar Swirl reaction DMG to opponents. This DMG can trigger CRIT Hits.
When the Stellar Vortex explodes, it will also grant nearby characters the ability to jump higher once, for a short time.
